questions.question: No empirical comparable-company base-rate dataset was available before the cutoff for assigning objective Bear/Base/Bull probabilities.

evidence.claim: McKinsey studied 5,000 of the world's largest public companies over 2005-2019. Only one in eight recorded revenue growth above 10% per year over the decade, and only one in three companies in the top growth quartile in 2009-2014 maintained that rate in the subsequent five years; among predominantly organic growers the persistence rate was one in four.
evidence.source_section: The ten rules of growth — empirical sample and Exhibit 1 discussion
evidence.source_origin: McKinsey The ten rules of growth (2022-08-12)

remaining_unknowns: No pre-cutoff empirical dataset was found that isolates Broadcom-like megacap custom-AI semiconductor companies; the available base rate is broad large-public-company evidence and must be used conservatively.
